summary: Source Workbench GUI and PWDT linked project/version/apply navigation use one guarded service. Verified current task source, and actual result membership with matching collection source for result links, are required before reads or selection/filter mutation. Returned linked versions must match the version ID and supplied project association before payload application. Version loading carries source/feedback ownership through application and checks workspace/API scope after final version-list refresh so superseded PWDT sequences cannot continue dependent writes. Project-only navigation detaches saved-model/version bindings without loading geometry or an arbitrary version list. Project catalog source metadata is weak, outside JSON and preserved by confirmed-removal filters/maps; project/version-list reads fence old-authority success and failure. Pure frontend and mocked Chromium controls exercise these source-client boundaries, not authenticated provenance, continuous record/authority history, cross-client locking, generic saved-model/project selection admission, installed WebView, remote or scientific qualification. No snapshot, backup, write replay, production Node dependency or operational-grade promotion is added.

required_text: Commit context with the validated payload
Project navigation does not load geometry
retained task links cannot authorize a new backend read
dependent SaveAs cannot follow a superseded context load
obsolete read cannot clear the live preview
source-preserving catalog maps retain the original scope
late completion cannot repeat context setters over newer editing
93 tests with zero failures or skips
